_comment: Frozen constants for the C1 build. Changing any value here invalidates the recorded baselines in `expected`.

bake._crossroad_note: 0 = leave CrossroadId -1 / Flags 0 (shipped Jeju plurality). Shipped Jeju has 2,908 nodes at Flags 4 but 6,244 with a CrossroadId, so our clustering does not reproduce the shipped spread; enable only after that shape is measured.

lanes.comment: LHT map: +1 is the leftmost lane so the AI-preferred lane is the slow lane. total_w = lane_width * (nf+nb); offsets measured from the road edges.

spawner.zeroed_rows: every other row, including Getaway and all service rows; the authoritative list is the embedded ROWS in tools/author_traffic_spawner.py — do not duplicate it here

expected._comment: Baseline for the 54-road (bbox-filtered) build. Re-record after any road set change; the verifier fails on drift.

expected_c1full._comment: C1Full full-map baseline (155 C1_Rd roads + C1_Course excluded). Re-record after any road-set change.
